is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii (M and S molecular forms) in southern Ghana (pages 1-3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotypes Vgsc-1014F (L995F/L1014F) in M and S forms (pages 1, 3, 8) and mentions Vgsc-1575Y (N1570Y) heterozygosity in S form individuals (page 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports Vgsc-1014F frequency in M forms in southern Ghana (mean +/- s.d. = 0.79 +/- 0.07; range 0.67-0.90) (page 3, Fig 3a), genotypes for 15 whole-genome sequenced individuals (5 M-wt, 5 M-kdr, 5 S-kdr; page 8), and annual sample sizes for M/S form collections (Fig 3b).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes collected from 18 field sites across southern Ghana between 2003 and 2013 (pages 3, 8, Fig 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper reporting whole-genome sequencing and field population surveys.

sub_country_location.evidence: Field collections were performed across 18 sites in southern Ghana, with 6 specific locations sampled in 2007 (pages 3, 8, Fig 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections are broken down by year (2003, 2006, 2007, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013; page 3, Fig 3b) and summer 2007 (page 8).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Figure 3a includes data redrawn from Lynd et al. (2010, ref 33) combined with new data points ('with additional data points (points shown as x)').

supplement.evidence: Per-site location details and specific sample numbers for the 2007 WGS collection locations are referenced in 'Supplementary Table 4' (page 8), which is not included in the provided text.

assessment.summary: This study investigates adaptive introgression of the Vgsc-1014F (L995F) resistance mutation between Anopheles gambiae s.s. (S form) and Anopheles coluzzii (M form) in southern Ghana. Using whole-genome sequencing of 15 individuals and multi-year field sampling (2003-2013 across 18 sites), the authors show that introgression of Vgsc-1014F transferred a ~3.3 Mb pericentromeric genomic island without disrupting reproductive isolation between the species.
